# STREETDARE

> STREETDARE is streetwear that helps people meet strangers. Each shirt has its own QR code on the back. Someone scans it, gets a dare, and the scanner and the wearer do it together, so breaking the ice feels easy. Started in Madrid and Budapest.

- Tagline: "The shirt that makes the first step."
- For: people aged roughly 18–32 who want to meet new people on nights out, at festivals, on trips and in everyday life.
- How it works: wear the shirt; someone scans the QR with their phone camera (no app, no login); they get a dare; if you both say yes, you do it together. Either person can always say no.
- Shirtless Pass: a way to play STREETDARE with friends for 24 hours without a shirt.
- Shirts are made to order, each with its owner's own QR code. Early members get the Founders' price.
- Founder: Aron, a Hungarian growth marketer based in Madrid.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/street.dare/
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@streetdare
